pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, blotchy patches with soft, blurred edge gradients. Geometry is non-angular; shapes are predominantly amorphous with significant pixel-level color blending at the margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, diffuse light pathways with broad intersection nodes. Pathways exhibit high pixel thickness relative to patch size, creating a continuous, high-contrast network.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark dorsal mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge showing low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background.
